 Bank of America (BAC) Bond Sales Keep The Undervalued Narrative In Play
 Bailey Pemberton Sat, November 7, 2026 at 8:11 AM PST 3 min read BAC -0.45% 
 Trade BAC on Coinbase Trading disclosure Trading disclosure

 Learn more Bank of America (BAC) has been active in the bond market, completing several fixed income offerings in recent days that add fresh senior unsecured funding across different maturities and coupon levels. 
 These bond sales come at a time when Bank of America's share price has eased back, with a 30 day share price return of down 7.66% and a 90 day share price return of down 21.77%. Even though the 3 year total shareholder return sits at 91.85%, recent momentum has faded while the longer term picture still reflects strong compounding for holders. 
 Seize this pullback in Bank of America to reassess your financials exposure and size up a curated group of potential rebound candidates with the 39 high quality undervalued stocks . 
 Bank of America now trades well below both its analyst price target and intrinsic value estimates after this pullback. Is that a simple valuation gap or a clear warning the market sees more risk than the models capture? 
 Most Popular Narrative: 21.7% Undervalued 
 On the most followed narrative, Bank of America screens as undervalued, with a fair value estimate of $63.14 versus the recent $49.42 close. This puts the current pullback against a backdrop of modeled earnings power and capital deployment plans. 
 The main thing that has to go right is that Bank of America converts its large core deposit base and existing consumer and workplace relationships into higher fee and wealth revenues while controlling an expense run rate around $18.6 billion per quarter. 
 The current valuation, in a narrative that views Bank of America as undervalued and bullish, implies the market is assigning limited value to plans for 6 to 8% annual net interest income growth, a 17 to 18% ROTCE target, and a $2 billion pretax opportunity from international expansion. 
 See why 386 investors see Bank of America as 22% undervalued . 
 Result: Fair Value of $63.14 (UNDERVALUED) 
 Still, the narrative can crack if softer capital markets activity persists or if higher regulatory and compliance costs continue to weigh on Bank of America's earnings power.
